_help.what: Settings for the headless daily agent (run_pipeline.py). Edit values below; keys starting with _ are ignored.
_help.data_dir: Folder holding the 3 input files. null = the folder above /webapp.
_help.files: Exact input filenames per role. Remove a name to let the agent guess it by keyword.
_help.sheets: Optional per-role sheet + header override, e.g. master: {sheet:'All SKU', header_row:1}. Leave empty to auto-detect.
_help.profile: The reviewed mapping saved from the web app's 'Save profile' button.
_help.database: Where clean rows are loaded. path is a NEW pipeline DB file by default so nothing existing is touched. Point it at your real sales database file once you've confirmed sheet + key_columns.
_help.qc.blocking: 'all' = every rule quarantines (except warn_only). 'none' = report only. Or a list of {column,type} to make only those block.
_help.qc.on_unevaluable: 'fail' = stop the run if a blocking rule cannot be checked (safest). 'warn' = continue.
_help.alert.email: Optional. Set enabled:true and fill host/user/to/from; put the SMTP password in the DT_SMTP_PASSWORD environment variable (never in this file).
